title: Quint B NDE 976
content:
I was in London, one night friends brought me to a young woman that was in delirium. (drugs or alcohol, I never found out) They had met her and didn't know what to do with her. I made her lie down , she cried, screamed, and I did what I could to calm her and talk softly and stroke her hair. I was 19 years old and did not know what else to do. After a long moment she calmed down and told me she was cold, so I connected an electric radiator. As no heat was coming forth, I met my one hand on the radiator and the other one on the socket. In that moment I was electrocuted. This is what I went through: I moved very quickly as drawn into and to a very strong and at the same time very sweet light. Then, in that light and sweetness, I was one with the other souls in total harmony. Our collective consciousness told me that I couldn't stay because I had something else to do Being part of this consciousness, and a bit disappointed that I had to leave I went back into my body. The return in my body was violent: I heard someone screaming and I understood that this was I who had come back. I opened my eyes, a friend who was a fireman living in the same building had heard me and had hurried to rescue me. A friend present told me that she saw me glued to the radiator and the socket and then jump backwards 2 or 3 meters and falling down on my bed. ( Where I regained the ground). I did not go to hospital, to me this was but a small incident. My whole body shook for several hours and the first night I found it difficult to get my feet back in this reality. Sounds, colors and sensations where almost painfully strong experiences.
